title: Carbon ionization and shell levels at Te=100 eV

method_references.scope: M(E) pressure-ionization weight and radial cutoff
finite-temperature average atom and ionic-density partition
Sec. 4.2 ionization definitions and negative-energy exterior matching used for shallow-state reliability

shell_charge_diagnostic.closure_policy: Every fresh point closes the complete shell table against Q_ion(R_WS) before reduction; the six displayed shells close 6-Zbar within 4e-6 electrons.

scientific_audit.policy: Shallow-level energies are omitted at marginal or unresolved numerical threshold points; shell Q_ion values that entered the converged partition remain auditable.
scientific_audit.ionization_definition_note: Zbar and Zstar are definition-dependent diagnostics. Zbar can be discontinuous at pressure ionization; Zstar is normally smooth but need not reproduce an intuitive chemical valence.
scientific_audit.continuum_edge_note: The plotted orbital energies use the explicitly configured local numerical edge V_eff(0.70 R_max), not the strict epsilon=0 lower limit of the Appendix-A continuum integral.
scientific_audit.level_tracking_note: The 1s, 2s, 2p, 3s, 3p, and 3d branches are displayed only while below the configured numerical continuum edge and reliable under the recorded threshold classification.

producer.provenance_limitation: The 72-state, 4096-point archive uses bound_occ_mode=fd, one continuum-edge convention, and one shell-Qion diagnostic. It ends at 450 g cm^-3; the 500 g cm^-3 production-FD solve did not converge. Data and producer checksums identify the uncommitted calculation state.
